gref.name: Memory Trade
gref.description: Frostwood's native memory merchants and Seelie spirits sift through memory-silt. Gref plucks a trivial memory from the target, trading it for a brief veil of evasion.

effects.name: Memory Loss
effects.description: Loses a minor memory; Gref gains full evasion for 3 rounds.

gref.name: Release Faces
gref.description: Frostwood's native memory merchants and Seelie spirits sift through memory-silt. Upends its barrow, unleashing trapped memories that dazzle and confuse nearby foes.

effects.name: Dazzled
effects.description: Dazzled and confused for 1 round.

gref.name: Mist Vanish
gref.description: Frostwood's native memory merchants and Seelie spirits sift through memory-silt. Dissolves into the twilight mist, becoming untargetable.

selectedEffects.name: Vanish
selectedEffects.description: Becomes invisible and untargetable for 1 round.

oillipheist.name: Silt Grasp
oillipheist.description: The bog-serpent's Thrumm-touch bubbles through stagnant water. A coiled maw of silt lashes out, dragging the victim into the bog.

effects.name: Grappled
effects.description: Pulled into difficult swamp water, restrained.

oillipheist.name: Blood Drain
oillipheist.description: The bog-serpent's Thrumm-touch bubbles through stagnant water. Needle-teeth sip the victim's blood, mending the serpent's silt-hide.

oillipheist.name: Blind-Sense
oillipheist.description: The bog-serpent's Thrumm-touch bubbles through stagnant water. Eyeless, it reads every vibration and blood-heat ripple in the water.

effects.name: Tremorsense
effects.description: Immune to blindness; detects all moving creatures within 30 ft in water.

grimmstalk.name: Skull Stare
grimmstalk.description: A Thrumm-croak echoes from the ironwood bird-skull. The hollow bird-skull fixes its gaze, freezing the victim in primal terror.

effects.name: Paralyzed with Terror
effects.description: Paralyzed for 1 round.

grimmstalk.name: Feather Slash
grimmstalk.description: A Thrumm-croak echoes from the ironwood bird-skull. Razor-edged ironwood plumage rakes across the target.

grimmstalk.name: Canopy Jump
grimmstalk.description: A Thrumm-croak echoes from the ironwood bird-skull. Swings between branches, teleporting across the canopy without provoking attacks.

selectedEffects.name: Canopy Teleport
selectedEffects.description: Teleports up to 40 ft, avoiding opportunity attacks.

pooka.name: Shift Form
pooka.description: The shape-shifting fey magic of the Pooka blurs form and memory. Collapses into a sleek wild pony, doubling its speed.

selectedEffects.name: Pony Form
selectedEffects.description: Movement speed doubled for 3 rounds.

pooka.name: Distract
pooka.description: The shape-shifting fey magic of the Pooka blurs form and memory. A flurry of impossible shape-shifts bewilders the target.

effects.name: Distracted
effects.description: Dazed by sudden shifts; Pooka gains evasion.

pooka.name: Hoof Kick
pooka.description: The shape-shifting fey magic of the Pooka blurs form and memory. A swift kick from cloven hooves.

schratling.name: Compulsive Scribe
schratling.description: A schratling's fey-ink stains the fabric of recollection. Rewrites any text within reach, scrambling scripts and scrolls.

effects.name: Scrambled Text
effects.description: Scrolls and written magic within 10 ft are corrupted for 2 rounds.

schratling.name: Peat-Ink Spit
schratling.description: A schratling's fey-ink stains the fabric of recollection. Hawks a globule of black peat-ink that unspools a trivial memory.

schratling.name: Moss-Camouflage
schratling.description: A schratling's fey-ink stains the fabric of recollection. Bark-skin blends seamlessly with the forest floor.

effects.name: Forest Camouflage
effects.description: +4 to stealth checks in forest terrain.

tatzelvine.name: Serpent-Lunge
tatzelvine.description: The tatzelvine's venom carries the Dimming's slow forgetfulness. Coils and strikes with venom-dripping fangs.

tatzelvine.name: Memory-Venom
tatzelvine.description: The tatzelvine's venom carries the Dimming's slow forgetfulness. Wounds weep a venom that dissolves short-term memory into confusion.

effects.name: Confused
effects.description: Loses memory of the last hour; confused for 2 rounds.

tatzelvine.name: Branch-Grip
tatzelvine.description: The tatzelvine's venom carries the Dimming's slow forgetfulness. Moves fluidly through the canopy, never provoking attacks.

effects.name: Canopy Movement
effects.description: Can move across canopy without provoking opportunity attacks.

drudehaunt.name: Fog-Shroud
drudehaunt.description: The Drudehaunt's fey-tinged shroud reeks of stale dreams. Perpetually blurred by drifting fog; ranged attacks falter.

effects.name: Blurred
effects.description: Ranged attacks against the Drudehaunt have disadvantage.

drudehaunt.name: Nightmare-Seal
drudehaunt.description: The Drudehaunt's fey-tinged shroud reeks of stale dreams. Seals a sleeper in a waking nightmare, harvesting memories as they wake.

effects.name: Nightmare Paralysis
effects.description: Paralyzed in a nightmare; 2d8 psychic on waking.

drudehaunt.name: Washbasin-Stare
drudehaunt.description: The Drudehaunt's fey-tinged shroud reeks of stale dreams. An AoE of dread radiates from her washing-basin.

effects.name: Frightened
effects.description: Frightened for 3 rounds.

koboldknock.name: Rivet-Hammer
koboldknock.description: The kobold's Thrumm-coded taps echo through the stone. A precise hammer-blow that rings like a struck rivet.

koboldknock.name: Coded-Tap
koboldknock.description: The kobold's Thrumm-coded taps echo through the stone. Taps walls in coded patterns, revealing veins and hazards.

effects.name: Mineral Sense
effects.description: Reveals nearby mineral veins and structural hazards to the GM.

koboldknock.name: Fog-Seal
koboldknock.description: The kobold's Thrumm-coded taps echo through the stone. Hammers a crack shut, sealing fog from a corridor.

selectedEffects.name: Sealed Crack
selectedEffects.description: Blocks fog from entering a 10-ft corridor for 1 hour.

erlkings_hound.name: Triple-Bark
erlkings_hound.description: The Erlking's fey-hound bays at the edge of remembering. Three escalating barks: terror, forgetting, then a walk into the deep fog.

effects.name: Frozen with Terror
effects.description: Frozen 1 round (Bark 1); may forget location (Bark 2).

erlkings_hound.name: Bark-Shriek
erlkings_hound.description: The Erlking's fey-hound bays at the edge of remembering. A cone-shape sonic shriek that rattles the bones.

erlkings_hound.name: Leaf-Shift
erlkings_hound.description: The Erlking's fey-hound bays at the edge of remembering. Its leafy coat regenerates endlessly in the forest.

effects.name: Forest Regeneration
effects.description: Heals 5 HP per round while in forest terrain.

nuckelmist.name: Trample
nuckelmist.description: The Nuckelmist's Thrumm-presence erases paths through the old magic. A massive limb flattens the target into the muck.

effects.name: Knocked Prone
effects.description: Knocked prone by the trample.

nuckelmist.name: Ink-Weep
nuckelmist.description: The Nuckelmist's Thrumm-presence erases paths through the old magic. Weeps a bolt of memory-ink that erases a major recollection.

nuckelmist.name: Path-Erasure Aura
nuckelmist.description: The Nuckelmist's Thrumm-presence erases paths through the old magic. A 50-ft aura rots all organic matter; the very path behind it vanishes.

effects.name: Blight Aura
effects.description: 50-ft radius: organic material rots, journals dissolve.

mossmaiden.name: Goat-Kick
mossmaiden.description: The Mossmaiden's fey-bargain binds flesh to the grove's Thrumm. A bone-cracking kick that launches the victim backward.

mossmaiden.name: Blood-Milk Bargain
mossmaiden.description: The Mossmaiden's fey-bargain binds flesh to the grove's Thrumm. Offers a wooden cup; the drinker is bound to her grove but grows hardy.

effects.name: undefined modification
effects.description: +4 Constitution, but bound to the grove.

mossmaiden.name: Seasonal-Camouflage
mossmaiden.description: The Mossmaiden's fey-bargain binds flesh to the grove's Thrumm. Moss-skin shifts hue with the temperature.

effects.name: Forest Camouflage
effects.description: +6 to stealth in forest terrain.

fachanwatch.name: Ironwood-Club
fachanwatch.description: The Fachan's single Thrumm-eye sees through fog and lies. A two-handed ironwood swing that can stun.

fachanwatch.name: Fog-Anchor
fachanwatch.description: The Fachan's single Thrumm-eye sees through fog and lies. Stabilizes spatial memory in a 100-ft radius; fog cannot erase paths.

effects.name: Path Stabilization
effects.description: Paths within 100 ft cannot be erased by memory-fog.

fachanwatch.name: Balanced-Stance
fachanwatch.description: The Fachan's single Thrumm-eye sees through fog and lies. Rooted like the mountain; immovable.

effects.name: Immovable
effects.description: Immune to knockback, prone, and shove effects.

knockbrew.name: Cork-Tooth Bite
knockbrew.description: Knockbrew's fey-brew ferments forgotten hours into mead. A nip from blunt cork-teeth.

knockbrew.name: Forget-Mead
knockbrew.description: Knockbrew's fey-brew ferments forgotten hours into mead. Offers a cup that dissolves the last hour from memory.

effects.name: Memory Wipe
effects.description: Loses memory of the last hour (or a full day per cup).

knockbrew.name: Cask-Tending
knockbrew.description: Knockbrew's fey-brew ferments forgotten hours into mead. Any alcohol it tends never spoils or freezes.

effects.name: Preservation
effects.description: Tended alcohol never spoils or freezes.

moorboggle.name: Sinkhole
moorboggle.description: The Moorboggle's Thrumm-sinkhole swallows memory into the old magic. Opens a temporary bog-sinkhole that swallows the victim.

moorboggle.name: Memory-Drain
moorboggle.description: The Moorboggle's Thrumm-sinkhole swallows memory into the old magic. A 10-ft aura slowly peels away minor memories.

effects.name: Memory Drain
effects.description: Loses one minor memory each round.

moorboggle.name: Amorphous
moorboggle.description: The Moorboggle's Thrumm-sinkhole swallows memory into the old magic. A boneless mass that ignores grapples and criticals.

effects.name: Amorphous
effects.description: Immune to grapple, prone, and critical hits; squeezes through any gap.

banshrond.name: Memory-Keen
banshrond.description: The Banshrond's fey-wail crystallizes grief into sharp-edged Thrumm. A wail that shreds memory; one ally loses a significant recollection.

banshrond.name: Tear-Glass
banshrond.description: The Banshrond's fey-wail crystallizes grief into sharp-edged Thrumm. Hurls a shard of crystallized grief that slows the target.

effects.name: Slowed
effects.description: Slowed for 2 rounds.

banshrond.name: Shroud-Weave
banshrond.description: The Banshrond's fey-wail crystallizes grief into sharp-edged Thrumm. Swirling ghost-pages deflect ranged attacks.

effects.name: Page-Shroud
effects.description: Ranged attacks have a 50% miss chance.

sluagh.name: Memory Peck
sluagh.description: The Sluagh's Wyrd-flock pecks at the threads of identity. A flurry of beaks pecks away the victim's name.

sluagh.name: Swarm-Body
sluagh.description: The Sluagh's Wyrd-flock pecks at the threads of identity. A living cloud of corvids; single-target attacks pass through.

effects.name: Swarm
effects.description: Immune to grapple, prone, and single-target physical attacks.

sluagh.name: Whirlwind
sluagh.description: The Sluagh's Wyrd-flock pecks at the threads of identity. The flock becomes a cyclone of feathers and claws.

wildejagd.name: Archive-Storm
wildejagd.description: The Wilde Jagd's Thrumm-hunt tramples through the Archive of memory. A vortex of parchment and forgotten lineage tears at the mind.

wildejagd.name: Page-Rain
wildejagd.description: The Wilde Jagd's Thrumm-hunt tramples through the Archive of memory. Sheets of razor-paper rain down, pinning the target.

effects.name: Restrained
effects.description: Restrained by paper for 1 round.

wildejagd.name: Name-Whisper
wildejagd.description: The Wilde Jagd's Thrumm-hunt tramples through the Archive of memory. Whispers forgotten ancestor-names, luring listeners closer.

effects.name: Whisper-Lure
effects.description: DC 14 SPI or charmed, walking toward the Sluagh.

fuath.name: Pool-Song
fuath.description: The Fuath's fey-pool reflects what the Dimming took. A haunting call that drags victims toward the black pool.

effects.name: Compelled
effects.description: Compelled to walk toward the pool.

fuath.name: Kelp-Grasp
fuath.description: The Fuath's fey-pool reflects what the Dimming took. Kelp-hair snares the victim and drags them under.

effects.name: Grappled
effects.description: Grappled and pulled underwater.

fuath.name: Dissolve
fuath.description: The Fuath's fey-pool reflects what the Dimming took. Merges with the pool-water, becoming undetectable.

selectedEffects.name: Full Concealment
selectedEffects.description: Indistinguishable from pool-water for 1 round.

grogoch.name: Spade-Strike
grogoch.description: The Grogoch's Thrumm-tunnels connect fey-nodes beneath the world. A clawed spade-hand slashes out of the dark.

grogoch.name: Tunnel-Network
grogoch.description: The Grogoch's Thrumm-tunnels connect fey-nodes beneath the world. Knows every tunnel within a mile.

effects.name: Tunnel Sense
effects.description: Knows and navigates all underground tunnels within 1 mile.

grogoch.name: Secret-Toll
grogoch.description: The Grogoch's Thrumm-tunnels connect fey-nodes beneath the world. Demands one personal secret for passage.

selectedEffects.name: Secret Bargain
selectedEffects.description: Demands a secret for passage; refuses to ever repeat it.

cailleach.name: Fog-Spinning
cailleach.description: The Cailleach's fey-distaff spins fog from Thrumm-threads. Spawns memory-fog in a wide radius, dissolving minor memories.

effects.name: Memory-Fog
effects.description: DC 14 SPI each round or lose one minor memory.

cailleach.name: Distaff-Strike
cailleach.description: The Cailleach's fey-distaff spins fog from Thrumm-threads. A whistling blow from her rune-carved distaff.

cailleach.name: Straw-Judgment
cailleach.description: The Cailleach's fey-distaff spins fog from Thrumm-threads. Fills a negligent household's belly with straw.

effects.name: Belly of Straw
effects.description: Incapacitated for 24 hours; not lethal but deeply disturbing.

dullahan.name: Fear-Mirror
dullahan.description: The Dullahan's fey-mask reflects what the Thrumm remembers. Its mask reflects the viewer's deepest fear.

effects.name: Frightened
effects.description: Frightened for 3 rounds.

dullahan.name: Spine-Whip
dullahan.description: The Dullahan's fey-mask reflects what the Thrumm remembers. A barbed spine lashes out, dragging the victim closer.

effects.name: Pulled
effects.description: Pulled 10 ft toward the rider.

dullahan.name: Fog-Mount
dullahan.description: The Dullahan's fey-mask reflects what the Thrumm remembers. Its steed is woven of fog; immune to physical harm.

effects.name: Fog-Mount
effects.description: Mount immune to physical damage; takes double radiant.

cusith.name: Three-Bark-Hunt
cusith.description: The Cu Sith's Thrumm-bark freezes the old magic in living veins. Escalating barks that freeze, erase location, then drive the victim into the fog.

effects.name: Frozen
effects.description: Frozen 1 round, then forgets location.

cusith.name: Moss-Touch
cusith.description: The Cu Sith's Thrumm-bark freezes the old magic in living veins. A chill, moss-draped paw strikes with rime.

cusith.name: Fear-Drain
cusith.description: The Cu Sith's Thrumm-bark freezes the old magic in living veins. Feeds on the memory of fear; frightened foes lose it forever.

effects.name: Fear-Drain
effects.description: Frightened creatures within 30 ft permanently lose the emotional memory of fear.

pixie.name: Spore-Burst
pixie.description: The Pixie's fey-spores luminesce with Thrumm-frequency. A puff of luminous spores that blinds nearby foes.

effects.name: Blinded
effects.description: Blinded for 1 round.

pixie.name: Spore-Trail
pixie.description: The Pixie's fey-spores luminesce with Thrumm-frequency. Leaves a colored trail whose hue hints at safety or danger.

pixie.name: Glow-Pulse
pixie.description: The Pixie's fey-spores luminesce with Thrumm-frequency. Doubles its light, illuminating a wide radius.

effects.name: Illumination
effects.description: Illuminates 40 ft.

waldschrat.name: Red-Cap-Spark
waldschrat.description: The Waldschrat's Thrumm-root drinks fear from the fey-soil. Flicks a tiny ember from its crimson cap.

waldschrat.name: Root-Rattle
waldschrat.description: The Waldschrat's Thrumm-root drinks fear from the fey-soil. A clattering rattle of roots deafens nearby foes.

effects.name: Deafened
effects.description: Deafened for 1 round.

waldschrat.name: Fear-Feed
waldschrat.description: The Waldschrat's Thrumm-root drinks fear from the fey-soil. Grows stronger near frightened creatures.

effects.name: Fear-Feed
effects.description: +2 to all rolls for each frightened creature within 30 ft.

fossegrim_ice.name: Ice-Fiddle
fossegrim_ice.description: The Fossegrim's winter-fiddle plays Thrumm-harmonics on frozen strings. A keening fiddle that compels all who hear it to dance.

effects.name: Compelled Dance
effects.description: Charmed and compelled to dance for 3 rounds.

fossegrim_ice.name: Ram-Skull-Bash
fossegrim_ice.description: The Fossegrim's winter-fiddle plays Thrumm-harmonics on frozen strings. A charging headbutt from a horned skull.

fossegrim_ice.name: Skate-Walk
fossegrim_ice.description: The Fossegrim's winter-fiddle plays Thrumm-harmonics on frozen strings. Glides across ice without slipping or breaking through.

effects.name: Ice-Walk
effects.description: Moves across ice without penalty or breaking through.

marepress.name: Nightmare-Crush
marepress.description: The Marepress's winter-hooves press Thrumm-nightmares into sleeping minds. Settles on a sleeper's chest, paralyzing them in a feeding dream.

effects.name: Nightmare
effects.description: Paralyzed; takes 2d6 psychic/round; Marepress heals the same.

marepress.name: Frost-Aura
marepress.description: The Marepress's winter-hooves press Thrumm-nightmares into sleeping minds. A 10-ft aura of killing frost.

effects.name: Frost Aura
effects.description: 10-ft radius: non-cold-resistant creatures take 1d6 frost/round.

marepress.name: Black-Ice-Hoofprint
marepress.description: The Marepress's winter-hooves press Thrumm-nightmares into sleeping minds. Leaves black-ice prints that topple pursuers.

effects.name: Slip
effects.description: Slips and falls prone.

krampuskin.name: Birch-Whip
krampuskin.description: Krampus's winter-chains rattle with the Thrumm of judgment. A lashing birch switch that opens bleeding wounds.

krampuskin.name: Horn-Gore
krampuskin.description: Krampus's winter-chains rattle with the Thrumm of judgment. A devastating horn-charge.

krampuskin.name: Chain-Rattle
krampuskin.description: Krampus's winter-chains rattle with the Thrumm of judgment. The miles-carrying clatter of chains weighs on the guilty.

effects.name: Guilt-Weigh
effects.description: Creatures who hear the chains and feel guilt take -2 to all saves.

klabatskerry.name: Caulk-Seal
klabatskerry.description: The Klabatskerry's Thrumm-caulking seals winter-cracks in the hull. Seals hull-cracks with frost-sealant stronger than tar.

selectedEffects.name: Hull Seal
selectedEffects.description: Seals cracks; the structure never sinks from ice-damage.

klabatskerry.name: Mallet-Strike
klabatskerry.description: The Klabatskerry's Thrumm-caulking seals winter-cracks in the hull. A sturdy mallet-blow.

klabatskerry.name: Bell-Chest
klabatskerry.description: The Klabatskerry's Thrumm-caulking seals winter-cracks in the hull. A bell in its chest rings softly when danger nears.

effects.name: Early Warning
effects.description: Rings when danger approaches within 100 ft.

perchtar.name: Procession-Sweep
perchtar.description: The Perchten's winter-masks parade through Thrumm-woven midwinter. The entire procession sweeps the area in a blizzard of masks.

perchtar.name: Mask-Judgment
perchtar.description: The Perchten's winter-masks parade through Thrumm-woven midwinter. Judges the negligent; none may sleep while the Schiachpercht marches.

effects.name: Exhaustion
effects.description: 1d6 exhaustion damage each hour the masks walk.

perchtar.name: Wyrd-Clear
perchtar.description: The Perchten's winter-masks parade through Thrumm-woven midwinter. Where it passes, Wyrd-corruption is driven out for a month.

effects.name: Month-Clear
effects.description: Clears all Wyrd-corruption in the region for one month.

helhest.name: Three-Legged-Charge
helhest.description: The Helhest's three-legged Thrumm-gait heralds the old magic of plague. A trampling gallop on three legs.

helhest.name: Plague-Aura
helhest.description: The Helhest's three-legged Thrumm-gait heralds the old magic of plague. A 50-ft aura of creeping plague.

effects.name: Plague
effects.description: The eldest and youngest in any settlement visited sicken within a week.

helhest.name: Coffin-Hoof
helhest.description: The Helhest's three-legged Thrumm-gait heralds the old magic of plague. A single hoofbeat like a closing coffin-lid frightens all who hear.

effects.name: Frightened
effects.description: Frightened for 1 hour.

myling.name: Weight-Bearing
myling.description: The Myling's winter-weight presses with the Thrumm of unquiet graves. Latches onto a back, growing heavier each round.

effects.name: Crushing Weight
effects.description: Starts at 20 lbs, +20 lbs/round; failed STR check crushes the carrier into the snow.

myling.name: Hearth-Release
myling.description: The Myling's winter-weight presses with the Thrumm of unquiet graves. If carried to a hearth-fire, the ice melts and the spirit is freed.

effects.name: Hearth-Release
effects.description: Resolved peacefully if carried to a hearth-fire.

myling.name: Rune-Glow
myling.description: The Myling's winter-weight presses with the Thrumm of unquiet graves. Scratched name-runes glow, revealing the Myling's identity.

effects.name: Name-Glow
effects.description: Runes glow to reveal the spirit's true name.

jutul.name: Roll-Attack
jutul.description: The Jutul's Thrumm-core pulses through its stone-veined winter-body. An immense boulder-charge that can pin the victim.

jutul.name: Stone-Regeneration
jutul.description: The Jutul's Thrumm-core pulses through its stone-veined winter-body. Reknits its rocky hide each round.

effects.name: Regeneration
effects.description: Heals 10 HP per round; only concentrated runic light truly damages it.

jutul.name: Boulder-Sleep
jutul.description: The Jutul's Thrumm-core pulses through its stone-veined winter-body. Becomes indistinguishable from a natural boulder.

selectedEffects.name: Inert
selectedEffects.description: +10 to stealth; appears as a natural boulder.

lindwyrm.name: Cat-Claw-Strike
lindwyrm.description: The Lindwyrm's Thrumm-breath flash-freezes the old magic in the air. Raking claws of ice-edged talons.

lindwyrm.name: Frost-Breath
lindwyrm.description: The Lindwyrm's Thrumm-breath flash-freezes the old magic in the air. A cone of permafrost breath.

lindwyrm.name: Ice-Bore
lindwyrm.description: The Lindwyrm's Thrumm-breath flash-freezes the old magic in the air. Tunnels through permafrost, leaving glassy refreezing tunnels.

effects.name: Untrackable
effects.description: Tunnels through permafrost; cannot be tracked normally.

nidhoggr.name: Lamprey-Maw
nidhoggr.description: Nidhogg's winter-gnaw devours the Thrumm of broken oaths. A lamprey-mouthed bite that opens a bleeding wound.

nidhoggr.name: Foundation-Gnaw
nidhoggr.description: Nidhogg's winter-gnaw devours the Thrumm of broken oaths. Gnaws at bedrock, undermining whole structures over time.

selectedEffects.name: Undermine
selectedEffects.description: Infested structures develop cracks within months.

nidhoggr.name: Oath-Corrupt
nidhoggr.description: Nidhogg's winter-gnaw devours the Thrumm of broken oaths. Devours the runic energy of blood-oaths.

effects.name: Oath-Devour
effects.description: Consumes blood-oath runes; warriors lose supernatural rage permanently.

strandvasker.name: Shore-Call
strandvasker.description: The Strandvasker's winter-call mimics voices lost to the Thrumm-sea. Mimics lost crewmates' voices, luring hearers to the ice-edge.

effects.name: Compelled
effects.description: Compelled toward the ice-edge.

strandvasker.name: Rope-Grasp
strandvasker.description: The Strandvasker's winter-call mimics voices lost to the Thrumm-sea. A sodden rope loops and drags the victim toward the water.

strandvasker.name: Salt-Armor
strandvasker.description: The Strandvasker's winter-call mimics voices lost to the Thrumm-sea. A crust of salt-crystals reinforces its torso.

effects.name: Salt-Armor
effects.description: +3 to AC.

landvaettir.name: Boulder-Hurl
landvaettir.description: The Landvaettir's Thrumm-ward repels the old magic with sacred resonance. Hurls a boulder from the peak.

landvaettir.name: Dragon-Prohibition
landvaettir.description: The Landvaettir's Thrumm-ward repels the old magic with sacred resonance. Any draconic image triggers a burying snowslide.

effects.name: Buried Alive
effects.description: Buried in a snowslide.

landvaettir.name: Wyrd-Ward
landvaettir.description: The Landvaettir's Thrumm-ward repels the old magic with sacred resonance. A 200-ft ward that no winter-creature has ever breached.

effects.name: Wyrd-Ward
effects.description: 200-ft radius: hostile creatures (native and Wyrd-touched) cannot enter.

vettir.name: Storm-Herd
vettir.description: The Vettir's winter-form swirls with Thrumm-snow from the starless sky. Directs snowfall into a whiteout or clears a corridor.

effects.name: Whiteout
effects.description: Intensifies a blizzard to whiteout conditions for 3 rounds.

vettir.name: Invisible
vettir.description: The Vettir's winter-form swirls with Thrumm-snow from the starless sky. Has no physical body; perceived only through swirling snow.

effects.name: Bodiless
effects.description: Perceived only via effects (snow, whispers, temperature); cannot be attacked physically.

vettir.name: Whisper-Carry
vettir.description: The Vettir's winter-form swirls with Thrumm-snow from the starless sky. Carries voices across impossible distances.

selectedEffects.name: Voice-Carry
selectedEffects.description: Carries a message up to 1 mile; 50% chance of cryptic commentary added.

bergthrall.name: Gem-Throw
bergthrall.description: The Bergthrall's Thrumm-cut crystals store winter-light for the Archive. Hurls raw gemstones as ammunition.

bergthrall.name: Chisel-Hands
bergthrall.description: The Bergthrall's Thrumm-cut crystals store winter-light for the Archive. Chisel-tipped fingers stab.

bergthrall.name: Crystal-Cut
bergthrall.description: The Bergthrall's Thrumm-cut crystals store winter-light for the Archive. Cuts glacier-crystals used for light-scroll storage.

effects.name: Crystal-Cutter
effects.description: Produces crystals essential to the Archive's light-scroll system.

fenris.name: Puppy-Bite
fenris.description: Fenris's Thrumm-collar hums with the old magic of world-ending promises. A surprisingly powerful bite.

fenris.name: Bound-Hunter
fenris.description: Fenris's Thrumm-collar hums with the old magic of world-ending promises. Tracks oath-breakers across a hundred miles.

effects.name: Oath-Breaker Track
effects.description: Tracks any creature who broke a sworn vow within 100 miles.

fenris.name: Gleipnir-Collar
fenris.description: Fenris's Thrumm-collar hums with the old magic of world-ending promises. A braided collar that contains its true size.

effects.name: Gleipnir-Collar
effects.description: Collar prevents growth; if removed, becomes a continent-ending catastrophe.

disir.name: Hair-Grasp
disir.description: The Disir's winter-spindle weaves Thrumm-fate for the unworthy. A cold grasp of spectral hair.

disir.name: Ancestral-Judge
disir.description: The Disir's winter-spindle weaves Thrumm-fate for the unworthy. Blesses families that honor the dead with warmth and fertility.

effects.name: undefined modification
effects.description: +4 Constitution for the blessed.

disir.name: Spindle-Curse
disir.description: The Disir's winter-spindle weaves Thrumm-fate for the unworthy. Curses negligent households with frozen-blood spindles.

effects.name: Barren Curse
effects.description: Women in the household become barren until offerings resume.

valravn.name: Shadow-Wing
valravn.description: The Valravn's Thrumm-wing casts winter-shadows across the battlefield. A wing strike that blinds the target with black feathers.

valravn.name: Battlefield-Scent
valravn.description: The Valravn's Thrumm-wing casts winter-shadows across the battlefield. Gains tracking and extra damage against wounded prey.

effects.name: Battlefield-Scent
effects.description: +2 to hit and +1d6 physical damage against creatures below half health.

valravn.name: Heart-Devour
valravn.description: The Valravn's Thrumm-wing casts winter-shadows across the battlefield. Bites a bleeding, stunned, or dying target, devouring its heart and regaining health.

kraken.name: Tentacle-Slam
kraken.description: The Kraken's Thrumm-tentacles drag ships into the winter-deep. A massive tentacle slams and grapples.

effects.name: Grappled
effects.description: Grappled by the tentacle.

kraken.name: Beak-Crush
kraken.description: The Kraken's Thrumm-tentacles drag ships into the winter-deep. A beak descends on a grappled victim.

kraken.name: Ice-Breaker
kraken.description: The Kraken's Thrumm-tentacles drag ships into the winter-deep. Shatters the ice beneath a vessel.

selectedEffects.name: Ice-Shatter
selectedEffects.description: Shatters ice beneath a vessel; the ship sinks in 2 rounds.

marmennill.name: Harp-Song
marmennill.description: The Marmennill's winter-harp plays Thrumm-prophecies in coastal caves. A harp-song that compels listeners toward the fjord-edge.

effects.name: Dream-State
effects.description: Compelled toward the fjord-edge; whale-blubber earplugs negate.

marmennill.name: Bone-Harp-Bash
marmennill.description: The Marmennill's winter-harp plays Thrumm-prophecies in coastal caves. A clumsy bash with its bone harp.

marmennill.name: Oracle-Answer
marmennill.description: The Marmennill's winter-harp plays Thrumm-prophecies in coastal caves. Answers three future-questions in dense riddles—then dissolves into seawater.

selectedEffects.name: Three Riddles
selectedEffects.description: Answers 3 future-questions as impenetrable riddles; dies after the third.

havgammel.name: Form-Shift
havgammel.description: The Havgammel's Thrumm-shift mirrors intent through winter-reflection. Shifts between guiding mermaid and trapping serpent based on observer intent.

selectedEffects.name: Form-Shift
selectedEffects.description: Serpent-form creates ice-floes that trap ships.

havgammel.name: Coin-Bargain
havgammel.description: The Havgammel's Thrumm-shift mirrors intent through winter-reflection. A silver coin tossed before the nets yields overflowing harvests.

effects.name: undefined modification
effects.description: Grants overflowing harvests; pollution yields nets of carved bones.

havgammel.name: Scrimshaw-Necklace
havgammel.description: The Havgammel's Thrumm-shift mirrors intent through winter-reflection. A scrimshaw necklace depicts drowning scenes; study reveals sunken wrecks.

effects.name: Wreck-Sense
effects.description: Studying the necklace reveals locations of sunken wrecks.

pazuzu.name: Ash-Storm
pazuzu.description: Pazuzu's ember-ash storm carries Thrumm-corruption from the Emberspire depths. A scything cloud of razor ash.

pazuzu.name: Lion-Claw
pazuzu.description: Pazuzu's ember-ash storm carries Thrumm-corruption from the Emberspire depths. Raking lion-talons.

pazuzu.name: Scorpion-Sting
pazuzu.description: Pazuzu's ember-ash storm carries Thrumm-corruption from the Emberspire depths. A venomous stinger-strike.

tiamat.name: Magma-Breath
tiamat.description: Tiamat's Thrumm-veins run with magma and fey-chaos. A roaring cone of magma.

tiamat.name: Multi-Head-Strike
tiamat.description: Tiamat's Thrumm-veins run with magma and fey-chaos. Every head strikes a different target.

tiamat.name: Lava-Swim
tiamat.description: Tiamat's Thrumm-veins run with magma and fey-chaos. Swims through molten rock; fully fire-immune.

effects.name: Lava-Swim
effects.description: Moves through molten rock at full speed; immune to fire.

anzu.name: Talon-Dive
anzu.description: Anzu's Thrumm-crest flares with ember-light from before the Dimming. A plunging dive from the caldera-rim.

anzu.name: Golden-Crest-Flash
anzu.description: Anzu's Thrumm-crest flares with ember-light from before the Dimming. A blinding flare of its golden crest.

anzu.name: Obsidian-Talon-Ignite
anzu.description: Anzu's Thrumm-crest flares with ember-light from before the Dimming. Talons ignite dry material on contact.

effects.name: Ignite
effects.description: Melee attacks deal +1d6 fire.

girtablilu.name: Pincer-Crush
girtablilu.description: The Girtablilu's ember-stinger drips with Thrumm-blight from Emberspire. A vise-grip of chitinous pincers.

effects.name: Grappled
effects.description: Grappled in the pincers.

girtablilu.name: Stinger-Venom
girtablilu.description: The Girtablilu's ember-stinger drips with Thrumm-blight from Emberspire. A stinger-strike whose venom, in small doses, cures ember-sickness.

girtablilu.name: Vigilance-Stare
girtablilu.description: The Girtablilu's ember-stinger drips with Thrumm-blight from Emberspire. Golden eyes radiate sacred authority.

effects.name: Intimidated
effects.description: Unable to attack for 1 round.

ammit.name: Crocodile-Bite
ammit.description: Ammit's Thrumm-maw devours Wyrd-corrupted souls at the final gate. A bone-shearing crocodilian bite.

ammit.name: Lion-Charge
ammit.description: Ammit's Thrumm-maw devours Wyrd-corrupted souls at the final gate. A charging pounce that pins the victim.

ammit.name: Smolder-Hide
ammit.description: Ammit's Thrumm-maw devours Wyrd-corrupted souls at the final gate. Its body smolders; melee attackers burn on contact.

effects.name: Smolder-Hide
effects.description: Melee attackers take 1d6 fire on contact.

lamashtu.name: Donkey-Shriek
lamashtu.description: Lamashtu's ember-shriek rends the Thrumm-fabric of sanity. A devastating donkey-shriek.

effects.name: Stunned
effects.description: Stunned for 1 round.

lamashtu.name: Claw-Rake
lamashtu.description: Lamashtu's ember-shriek rends the Thrumm-fabric of sanity. Raking horror-claws.

lamashtu.name: Copper-Weep
lamashtu.description: Lamashtu's ember-shriek rends the Thrumm-fabric of sanity. Molten copper weeps from her, pocking basalt.

effects.name: Copper-Terrain
effects.description: Creates hazardous terrain dealing 1d6 fire per square.

bes.name: Tambourine-Bang
bes.description: Bes's Thrumm-tambourine rattles ember-chains from the mind. A tambourine whose laughter breaks enchantments and frightens hostile creatures.

effects.name: Frightened Flee
effects.description: Hostile creatures are frightened and must flee.

bes.name: Khopesh-Slash
bes.description: Bes's Thrumm-tambourine rattles ember-chains from the mind. A curving khopesh-stroke.

bes.name: Shatter-Sacrifice
bes.description: Bes's Thrumm-tambourine rattles ember-chains from the mind. Explodes into protective clay-shards, warding the area.

selectedEffects.name: Permanent Ward
selectedEffects.description: Creates a permanent 20-ft Wyrd-warding safe zone.

ifrit.name: Coal-Hurl
ifrit.description: The Ifrit's Thrumm-coal glows with ember-fire from Emberspire's core. Hurls a searing coal.

ifrit.name: Cobra-Glare
ifrit.description: The Ifrit's Thrumm-coal glows with ember-fire from Emberspire's core. A gaze that ignites the flammable and sets foes ablaze.

effects.name: Ablaze
effects.description: 3d6 fire damage; set ablaze.

ifrit.name: Flame-Body
ifrit.description: The Ifrit's Thrumm-coal glows with ember-fire from Emberspire's core. A body of living flame.

effects.name: Flame-Body
effects.description: Melee attackers take 2d6 fire on contact.

ghul.name: Fire-Bolt
ghul.description: The Ghul's Thrumm-bone cloak hides a furnace of embers. A streak of cinder-flame.

ghul.name: Bone-Cloak-Split
ghul.description: The Ghul's Thrumm-bone cloak hides a furnace of embers. Its cloak splits open, revealing a furnace within.

ghul.name: Invisible-Shift
ghul.description: The Ghul's Thrumm-bone cloak hides a furnace of embers. Becomes completely invisible (save for floating green eyes).

selectedEffects.name: Invisible
selectedEffects.description: Invisible for 1 round; DC 14 INT to spot the eyes.

gugalanna.name: Magma-Charge
gugalanna.description: Gugalanna's Thrumm-hooves crack the ember-crust of cooling basalt. A trampling magma-charge.

gugalanna.name: Steam-Breath
gugalanna.description: Gugalanna's Thrumm-hooves crack the ember-crust of cooling basalt. A cone of scalding steam.

gugalanna.name: Ground-Breaker
gugalanna.description: Gugalanna's Thrumm-hooves crack the ember-crust of cooling basalt. Its hooves crack cooling lava into navigation-maps.

effects.name: Navigation Tracks
effects.description: Following its tracks leads to stable ground.

peri.name: Proboscis-Touch
peri.description: The Peri's Thrumm-wings etch ember-prayers into the Emberspire air. A delicate touch that harms foes or mends allies.

peri.name: Runic-Prayer-Wings
peri.description: The Peri's Thrumm-wings etch ember-prayers into the Emberspire air. Wings edged with prayers grant a surge of spirit.

effects.name: undefined modification
effects.description: +4 Spirit for 1 hour.

peri.name: Wing-Roll
peri.description: The Peri's Thrumm-wings etch ember-prayers into the Emberspire air. Rolls dawn-thermal into a plantable sun-seed.

selectedEffects.name: Sun-Seed
selectedEffects.description: Creates a sun-seed that produces fire for a year when planted.

daeva.name: Chaos-Bite
daeva.description: The Daeva's Thrumm absorbs ember-light from the Emberspire sky. A bite of pure chaos.

daeva.name: Truth-Eater
daeva.description: The Daeva's Thrumm absorbs ember-light from the Emberspire sky. Feeds on spoken truth, weakening the honest.

effects.name: Honesty-Weakened
effects.description: Honest speakers take -1 to all rolls per truth; shade gains +5 HP per truth.

daeva.name: Light-Absorb
daeva.description: The Daeva's Thrumm absorbs ember-light from the Emberspire sky. A three-dimensional hole in the world; visible only as a silhouette.

effects.name: Light-Absorb
effects.description: All non-radiant damage reduced 75%.

simurgh.name: Talon-Strike
simurgh.description: The Simurgh's Thrumm-feathers knit Wyrd-broken bones with sacred thread. A raking talon-strike.

simurgh.name: Feather-Heal
simurgh.description: The Simurgh's Thrumm-feathers knit Wyrd-broken bones with sacred thread. Lays a healing feather that knits broken bones.

simurgh.name: Wing-Buffet
simurgh.description: The Simurgh's Thrumm-feathers knit Wyrd-broken bones with sacred thread. A hurricane wingbeat.

effects.name: Knocked Back
effects.description: Knocked back 20 ft and prone.

azi.name: Triple-Strike
azi.description: Azi's three Thrumm-heads breathe ember-elements from Emberspire's chaos. Three heads strike at once: fire, lightning, and acid.

azi.name: Tail-Whip
azi.description: Azi's three Thrumm-heads breathe ember-elements from Emberspire's chaos. A sweeping tail-strike.

azi.name: Obsidian-Hide
azi.description: Azi's three Thrumm-heads breathe ember-elements from Emberspire's chaos. Dinner-plate obsidian scales repel mortal weapons.

effects.name: Obsidian-Hide
effects.description: Non-magical weapons cannot pierce.

edimmu.name: Attachment-Bond
edimmu.description: The Edimmu's Thrumm-bond drains Wyrd-vitality through sulfurous touch. Bonds to a passing creature, sapping strength over days.

effects.name: Bonded Fatigue
effects.description: -1 to all rolls per day; spontaneous combustion on day 7.

edimmu.name: Heat-Mirage
edimmu.description: The Edimmu's Thrumm-bond drains Wyrd-vitality through sulfurous touch. Visible only in peripheral vision.

effects.name: Heat-Mirage
effects.description: DC 14 INT to track its position.

edimmu.name: Sulfur-Aura
edimmu.description: The Edimmu's Thrumm-bond drains Wyrd-vitality through sulfurous touch. Smells of sulfur and ancient dust.

effects.name: Sulfur-Aura
effects.description: Reveals its presence within 30 ft.

asag.name: Obsidian-Fist
asag.description: Asag's Thrumm-fist pounds ember-fire from Emberspire's molten deep. A magma-hot stone fist.

asag.name: Earth-Laugh
asag.description: Asag's Thrumm-fist pounds ember-fire from Emberspire's molten deep. A localized magnitude-5 quake.

asag.name: Boiling-Presence
asag.description: Asag's Thrumm-fist pounds ember-fire from Emberspire's molten deep. Water within 30 ft literally boils.

effects.name: Boiling Zone
effects.description: 30-ft radius: scalding terrain deals 2d6 fire to anyone entering.

nisroch.name: Wedjat-Beam
nisroch.description: Nisroch's Thrumm-eye beams Wyrd-purging light across the wastes. A beam of concentrated light from the left eye; double damage to ember.

nisroch.name: Bronze-Talon
nisroch.description: Nisroch's Thrumm-eye beams Wyrd-purging light across the wastes. A diving bronze-talon rake.

nisroch.name: Sky-Patrol
nisroch.description: Nisroch's Thrumm-eye beams Wyrd-purging light across the wastes. Patrols the skies scanning for ember-manifestations.

effects.name: Sky-Patrol
effects.description: Acts as an early-warning system for hostile creatures and Wyrd entities.

abzu.name: Wisdom-Well
abzu.description: Abzu's Thrumm-spring feeds ember-knowledge to Emberspire's forges. Those who drink receive forgotten knowledge—for a drop of blood.

effects.name: undefined modification
effects.description: Grants one piece of pre-Dimming knowledge.

abzu.name: Volcanic-Coolant
abzu.description: Abzu's Thrumm-spring feeds ember-knowledge to Emberspire's forges. Its spring feeds cooling-channels beneath the forges.

selectedEffects.name: Coolant Spring
selectedEffects.description: Prevents the forges from overheating.

abzu.name: Water-Form
abzu.description: Abzu's Thrumm-spring feeds ember-knowledge to Emberspire's forges. A stationary pool; immune to physical damage.

effects.name: Water-Form
effects.description: Immune to physical damage; vulnerable to cold (freezes).

kur_pit.name: Underworld-Mouth
kur_pit.description: The Kur Pit's Thrumm-mouth opens into the ember-labyrinth below. A perfectly circular pit opens without warning.

effects.name: Trapped in Labyrinth
effects.description: Trapped in the labyrinth between Kur and Duat.

kur_pit.name: Abyssal-Grip
kur_pit.description: The Kur Pit's Thrumm-mouth opens into the ember-labyrinth below. A gravitational pull toward the pit's edge.

effects.name: Sliding
effects.description: Slides 5 ft closer to the pit each round.

kur_pit.name: Murmur-of-Dead
kur_pit.description: The Kur Pit's Thrumm-mouth opens into the ember-labyrinth below. Countless voices in dead languages shake the will.

effects.name: Shaken
effects.description: -2 to all checks.

mushussu.name: Nub-Horn-Bonk
mushussu.description: The Mushussu's Thrumm-breath quickens the old magic in living things. A clumsy baby-horn bonk.

mushussu.name: Life-Breath
mushussu.description: The Mushussu's Thrumm-breath quickens the old magic in living things. Its breath accelerates plant growth.

effects.name: undefined modification
effects.description: A visited garden produces double yields.

mushussu.name: Imprint-Follow
mushussu.description: The Mushussu's Thrumm-breath quickens the old magic in living things. Imprints on the first kind creature it meets.

effects.name: Imprint
effects.description: Encourages the adult Sirrush to guard the imprinted creature's village.

sirrush.name: Dragon-Breath
sirrush.description: The Sirrush's Thrumm-scales deflect ember-energies like water. A streaming gout of drake-fire.

sirrush.name: Serrated-Talon
sirrush.description: The Sirrush's Thrumm-scales deflect ember-energies like water. A rending talon-rake.

sirrush.name: Scaled-Ward
sirrush.description: The Sirrush's Thrumm-scales deflect ember-energies like water. Glittering scales turn aside elemental harm.

effects.name: Scaled-Ward
effects.description: Resistant to fire and frost.

aswad.name: Ember-Spit
aswad.description: The Aswad's Thrumm-jar breathes embers from Emberspire's ash. Hawks a clot of embers from its jar.

aswad.name: Soot-Shield
aswad.description: The Aswad's Thrumm-jar breathes embers from Emberspire's ash. Vents smoke, blurring its form against ranged attacks.

selectedEffects.name: Soot-Veil
selectedEffects.description: DC 12 AGI to hit with ranged attacks.

aswad.name: Ember-Resist
aswad.description: The Aswad's Thrumm-jar breathes embers from Emberspire's ash. Born of embers; unharmed by flame.

effects.name: Ember-Resist
effects.description: Immune to fire damage; vulnerable to water.

serpopard.name: Serpentine-Lunge
serpopard.description: The Serpopard's Thrumm-sway hypnotizes with ember-ancient rhythms. A long-necked lunge that grapples.

effects.name: Grappled
effects.description: Grappled by the long neck.

serpopard.name: Constrict
serpopard.description: The Serpopard's Thrumm-sway hypnotizes with ember-ancient rhythms. Crushing coils against a grappled victim.

serpopard.name: Hypnotic-Sway
serpopard.description: The Serpopard's Thrumm-sway hypnotizes with ember-ancient rhythms. A swaying, hypnotic dance.

effects.name: Charmed
effects.description: Charmed for 2 rounds.

lamassu.name: Runic-Stomp
lamassu.description: The Lamassu's Thrumm-stomp grounds ember-chaos with runic order. A stunning hoof-strike charged with runes.

lamassu.name: Sunburst-Wing
lamassu.description: The Lamassu's Thrumm-stomp grounds ember-chaos with runic order. Wings flare in a blinding sunburst.

effects.name: Blinded
effects.description: Blinded by radiant light for 1 round.

lamassu.name: Stone-Ward
lamassu.description: The Lamassu's Thrumm-stomp grounds ember-chaos with runic order. Sacred stone-hide turns aside blows.

effects.name: Stone-Ward
effects.description: Takes 5 less damage from physical attacks.

mamiri.name: Song-Lure
mamiri.description: The Mamiri's Thrumm-song traverses Iceheart's tide-laced currents. An irresistible song pulling victims toward the reef.

effects.name: Compelled
effects.description: Overwhelming compulsion to move toward the Siren.

mamiri.name: Kelp-Hair-Grasp
mamiri.description: The Mamiri's Thrumm-song traverses Iceheart's tide-laced currents. Kelp-hair snares and grapples.

mamiri.name: Cowrie-Crown-Bargain
mamiri.description: The Mamiri's Thrumm-song traverses Iceheart's tide-laced currents. Offers a binding deal sealed with a cowrie shell.

selectedEffects.name: Binding Bargain
selectedEffects.description: Wealth or passage for a treasure, secret, or years of life.

charybdis.name: Whirlpool-Vortex
charybdis.description: Charybdis's Thrumm-vortex grinds tide-memory into the abyss. Anchors in narrow channels, dragging vessels in.

charybdis.name: Lamprey-Throat
charybdis.description: Charybdis's Thrumm-vortex grinds tide-memory into the abyss. A lamprey-mouthed bite that swallows.

charybdis.name: Leopard-Scale-Flash
charybdis.description: Charybdis's Thrumm-vortex grinds tide-memory into the abyss. Disorienting flashing scales at the vortex edge.

effects.name: Confused
effects.description: Confused for 1 round.

ketos.name: Elephant-Tusk-Ram
ketos.description: Ketos's Thrumm-bulk displaces tides across the Iceheart Sea. A colossal tusk-ram that can hole a hull.

ketos.name: Swallow-Whole
ketos.description: Ketos's Thrumm-bulk displaces tides across the Iceheart Sea. A maw large enough to swallow a small ship.

effects.name: Swallowed
effects.description: Vessel and crew swallowed; 5d6 acid per round.

ketos.name: God's-Mistake-Intellect
ketos.description: Ketos's Thrumm-bulk displaces tides across the Iceheart Sea. An enormous, intelligent brain.

effects.name: God's-Mistake
effects.description: Psychic damage ignores 50% of its resistances.

harpy.name: Mast-Snatcher
harpy.description: The Harpy's Thrumm-hooks lock into the tide-rigging between worlds. Snatches crew from decks and lifts them away.

harpy.name: Feather-Slash
harpy.description: The Harpy's Thrumm-hooks lock into the tide-rigging between worlds. A raking wing-claw.

harpy.name: Iron-Hook-Feet
harpy.description: The Harpy's Thrumm-hooks lock into the tide-rigging between worlds. Curved iron-hooks lock it to the rigging.

effects.name: Iron-Hook-Feet
effects.description: Cannot be dislodged without dealing 20 damage or breaking the mast.

hippocampus.name: Wave-Crest
hippocampus.description: The Hippocampus's Thrumm-crest parts the tide-waters of the Iceheart. Raises waves to speed allies and bog enemies.

effects.name: undefined modification
effects.description: Allies +10 swim speed; enemies find water difficult.

hippocampus.name: Hoof-Fin-Steer
hippocampus.description: The Hippocampus's Thrumm-crest parts the tide-waters of the Iceheart. A lashing hoof-fin.

hippocampus.name: Estuary-Purify
hippocampus.description: The Hippocampus's Thrumm-crest parts the tide-waters of the Iceheart. Its presence purifies Wyrd-tainted water.

effects.name: Pure Water
effects.description: Drinking its water grants 24-hour immunity to water-borne disease.

gorgon.name: Stone-Gaze
gorgon.description: The Gorgon's Thrumm-gaze petrifies tide-threads in living flesh. A gaze that progressively petrifies.

effects.name: Petrifying
effects.description: Rd1: -10 speed; Rd2: restrained; Rd3: petrified.

gorgon.name: Eel-Hair-Hypnosis
gorgon.description: The Gorgon's Thrumm-gaze petrifies tide-threads in living flesh. Bioluminescent eel-hair pulses hypnotically.

effects.name: Entranced
effects.description: Entranced; can be pulled toward her without resistance.

gorgon.name: Firefly-Shift
gorgon.description: The Gorgon's Thrumm-gaze petrifies tide-threads in living flesh. Compresses into a tiny eel, becoming nearly invisible.

selectedEffects.name: Firefly-Form
selectedEffects.description: DC 16 INT to spot; drinks fish-blood in this form.

tokoloshe.name: Pebbble-Invisibility
tokoloshe.description: The Tokoloshe's Thrumm-pebble extinguishes Wyrd-presence from sight. Swallows a black pebble to vanish.

selectedEffects.name: Invisible
selectedEffects.description: Invisible; DC 14 INT to hear its breathing.

tokoloshe.name: Long-Arm-Grab
tokoloshe.description: The Tokoloshe's Thrumm-pebble extinguishes Wyrd-presence from sight. A snatch-and-steal.

tokoloshe.name: Bilge-Pest
tokoloshe.description: The Tokoloshe's Thrumm-pebble extinguishes Wyrd-presence from sight. Infests bilges, tangling rigging and sabotaging tools.

effects.name: Navigation Sabotage
effects.description: All Navigation checks DC +5 while it remains.

lamia.name: Reef-Grasp
lamia.description: The Lamia's Thrumm-lullaby echoes through Iceheart's tide-reefs. Inordinately long arms grapple and drag.

effects.name: Grappled
effects.description: Grappled and pulled from deck.

lamia.name: Grief-Lure
lamia.description: The Lamia's Thrumm-lullaby echoes through Iceheart's tide-reefs. A lullaby mimicking a grieving mother.

effects.name: Leaning
effects.description: Those who lost children lean into her reach.

lamia.name: Pearl-Tear
lamia.description: The Lamia's Thrumm-lullaby echoes through Iceheart's tide-reefs. Tears dissolve into pearl-trails that attract predators.

effects.name: Pearl-Trail
effects.description: Tears leave trails attracting predators.

empusa.name: Storm-Seduction
empusa.description: Empusa's Thrumm-limp disorients the tide-senses of her prey. Charms a lone victim and drains vitality.

empusa.name: Hammer-Skull-Staff
empusa.description: Empusa's Thrumm-limp disorients the tide-senses of her prey. A crackling staff-blow of brass and lightning.

empusa.name: Asymmetric-Walk
empusa.description: Empusa's Thrumm-limp disorients the tide-senses of her prey. The clicking brass-leg and donkey-hoof disorient foes.

effects.name: Disoriented
effects.description: -2 to attacks against her.

telkhine.name: Whale-Bone-Hammer
telkhine.description: The Telkhine's Thrumm-hammer forges tide-ice into unmelting weapons. A stunning whale-bone blow.

telkhine.name: Boat-Roll
telkhine.description: The Telkhine's Thrumm-hammer forges tide-ice into unmelting weapons. Overturns small boats, stripping their metal fittings.

effects.name: Overturned
effects.description: Boat overturned; only wood remains.

telkhine.name: Ice-Smith
telkhine.description: The Telkhine's Thrumm-hammer forges tide-ice into unmelting weapons. Forges weapons from deep-sea ice that never melt.

effects.name: Telkhine-Ice Weapon
effects.description: Forged weapons deal +1d6 frost damage.

stymphalian.name: Feather-Arrow
stymphalian.description: The Stymphalian's Thrumm-wings clatter with tide-disruption. Launches razor-feathers like arrows.

stymphalian.name: Metallic-Clatter
stymphalian.description: The Stymphalian's Thrumm-wings clatter with tide-disruption. The metallic wing-beat disrupts concentration.

effects.name: Distracted
effects.description: -2 to concentration.

stymphalian.name: Bronze-Rattle-Vulnerability
stymphalian.description: The Stymphalian's Thrumm-wings clatter with tide-disruption. Loud bronze rattles can drive the flock to flee.

effects.name: Flee
effects.description: Flock must flee.

nereid.name: Drowning-Savior
nereid.description: The Nereid's Thrumm-glow illuminates Iceheart's tide-blessed depths. Carries drowning sailors to the surface.

nereid.name: Breath-Withdraw
nereid.description: The Nereid's Thrumm-glow illuminates Iceheart's tide-blessed depths. Withdraws the breath of the sea from trespassers.

effects.name: Drowning
effects.description: Begins drowning.

nereid.name: Luminous-Form
nereid.description: The Nereid's Thrumm-glow illuminates Iceheart's tide-blessed depths. Emits soft blue-green light.

effects.name: Luminous
effects.description: +6 to Persuasion; illuminates 30 ft.

graeae.name: Shared-Obsidian-Eye
graeae.description: The Graeae's Thrumm-eye sees tide-fates through the Iceheart mist. The crones pass the eye to grant a prophetic answer.

selectedEffects.name: Prophecy
selectedEffects.description: One prophetic answer; refuse the tooth-price and receive a false prophecy.

graeae.name: Frost-Robe
graeae.description: The Graeae's Thrumm-eye sees tide-fates through the Iceheart mist. Robes crackling with frost burn melee attackers.

effects.name: Frost-Burn
effects.description: Melee attackers take 1d6 frost.

graeae.name: Tooth-Price
graeae.description: The Graeae's Thrumm-eye sees tide-fates through the Iceheart mist. Answers cost a tooth—extraction ensures truth.

selectedEffects.name: Tooth-Extraction
selectedEffects.description: Deals 1d4 damage; ensures the prophecy is true.

triton.name: Wave-Control
triton.description: The Triton's Thrumm-horn commands the tides of the Iceheart Sea. A horn-call raises a wall of water.

triton.name: Trident-Strike
triton.description: The Triton's Thrumm-horn commands the tides of the Iceheart Sea. A precise trident-thrust.

triton.name: Depth-Sovereign
triton.description: The Triton's Thrumm-horn commands the tides of the Iceheart Sea. His presence prevents lesser sea-monsters from attacking.

effects.name: Depth-Sovereign
effects.description: Lesser sea-monsters will not attack within 100 ft.

nandi.name: Skull-Crush
nandi.description: The Nandi's Thrumm-bristles insulate against Iceheart's tide-cold. A bone-crushing bite to the head.

nandi.name: Ice-Floe-Ambush
nandi.description: The Nandi's Thrumm-bristles insulate against Iceheart's tide-cold. Hides on ice-floes for an ambush.

effects.name: undefined modification
effects.description: +8 to stealth on ice; first attack has advantage.

nandi.name: Bristle-Float
nandi.description: The Nandi's Thrumm-bristles insulate against Iceheart's tide-cold. Greasy bristles trap air for buoyancy.

effects.name: Unsinkable
effects.description: Cannot be drowned.

popobawa.name: Single-Eye
popobawa.description: The Popobawa's Thrumm-gaze imprints tide-shame into the victim's soul. Staring at its one eye for too long terrifies.

effects.name: Frightened
effects.description: Frightened for 1 minute.

popobawa.name: Shame-Silence
popobawa.description: The Popobawa's Thrumm-gaze imprints tide-shame into the victim's soul. Victims are psychically silenced about the attack.

effects.name: Shame-Silenced
effects.description: Cannot speak of the attack until naming it publicly.

popobawa.name: Form-Cycle
popobawa.description: The Popobawa's Thrumm-gaze imprints tide-shame into the victim's soul. Shifts between dwarf, specter, and shadow each round.

effects.name: Form-Cycle
effects.description: Attacks of opportunity cannot target it.

abada.name: Horn-Purify
abada.description: The Abada's Thrumm-horn purifies Wyrd-taint from Iceheart's waters. Touching poisoned water with its horn purifies it.

selectedEffects.name: Purify Water
selectedEffects.description: Purifies a ship's water supply for a year.

abada.name: Narwhal-Bonk
abada.description: The Abada's Thrumm-horn purifies Wyrd-taint from Iceheart's waters. A playful horn-jab.

abada.name: Reef-Garden
abada.description: The Abada's Thrumm-horn purifies Wyrd-taint from Iceheart's waters. Tended reefs grow twice as fast and resist decay.

effects.name: Reef-Garden
effects.description: Tended reefs are immune to Wyrd-decay.

graia.name: Future-Face
graia.description: Graia's Thrumm-eddy bends time through tide-whorls in the current. Staring reveals your own older face—then the question comes.

effects.name: Compelled
effects.description: Compelled to answer: What will you pay?

graia.name: Grey-Passage
graia.description: Graia's Thrumm-eddy bends time through tide-whorls in the current. Ships passing through the center travel in time, not space.

selectedEffects.name: Grey-Passage
selectedEffects.description: Emerge having aged weeks, or vice versa; the swirl takes its cut.

graia.name: Still-Surface
graia.description: Graia's Thrumm-eddy bends time through tide-whorls in the current. The air above the eddy is unnaturally still.

effects.name: Calm Zone
effects.description: 60-ft radius of calm even during storms.

ichthya.name: Trident-Strike
ichthya.description: Ichthya's Thrumm-trident glows with tide-heat from the Iceheart forge. A red-hot trident-thrust.

ichthya.name: Horse-Uppercut
ichthya.description: Ichthya's Thrumm-trident glows with tide-heat from the Iceheart forge. A rearing uppercut.

ichthya.name: Wave-Forge
ichthya.description: Ichthya's Thrumm-trident glows with tide-heat from the Iceheart forge. Forges unbreakable weapons beneath the waves.

selectedEffects.name: Wave-Forged Gift
selectedEffects.description: Creates a trident/harpoon that never rusts, breaks, or misses.

brine.name: Safe-Harbor-Glow
brine.description: The Brine's Thrumm-lantern flickers with tide-guidance through the storm. Appears over safe anchorages during the worst storms.

selectedEffects.name: Safe Harbor
selectedEffects.description: Following it always leads to safety.

brine.name: False-Lantern
brine.description: The Brine's Thrumm-lantern flickers with tide-guidance through the storm. A corrupted lantern leads ships onto rocks.

effects.name: Misled
effects.description: Screaming faces inside; leads onto rocks.

brine.name: Soul-Light
brine.description: The Brine's Thrumm-lantern flickers with tide-guidance through the storm. Warm light comforts nearby creatures.

effects.name: undefined modification
effects.description: +2 to Spirit saves within 20 ft.

pelagos.name: Reef-Breaker
pelagos.description: Pelagos's Thrumm-tides drag the unwary into Iceheart's tide-depths. A crushing blow of coral-mass.

pelagos.name: Tidal-Pull
pelagos.description: Pelagos's Thrumm-tides drag the unwary into Iceheart's tide-depths. Draws foes into the surf.

effects.name: Dragged Under
effects.description: Dragged 15 ft into the water.

pelagos.name: Amphibious
pelagos.description: Pelagos's Thrumm-tides drag the unwary into Iceheart's tide-depths. Breathes water and land alike.

effects.name: Amphibious
effects.description: Can breathe underwater; swim 40.

egbere.name: Crying-Call
egbere.description: The Egbere's Thrumm-mat weeps with tide-sorrow from Iceheart's salt. A wailing cry that charms hearers closer.

effects.name: Compelled
effects.description: Compelled to move toward the Egbere.

egbere.name: Salt-Wave
egbere.description: The Egbere's Thrumm-mat weeps with tide-sorrow from Iceheart's salt. A 30-ft cone of stinging brine.

egbere.name: Mat-Shield
egbere.description: The Egbere's Thrumm-mat weeps with tide-sorrow from Iceheart's salt. Its woven mat wards off blows.

effects.name: Mat-Shield
effects.description: +4 defense while holding its mat.

scylla_crab.name: Obsidian-Claw
scylla_crab.description: Scylla's Thrumm-claws crack tide-frozen ice beneath the waves. An armor-piercing obsidian claw-strike.

scylla_crab.name: Ice-Cutter
scylla_crab.description: Scylla's Thrumm-claws crack tide-frozen ice beneath the waves. Pins the victim's leg, halving speed.

effects.name: Leg Pinned
effects.description: Speed halved.

scylla_crab.name: Volcanic-Steam
scylla_crab.description: Scylla's Thrumm-claws crack tide-frozen ice beneath the waves. Vents a scalding cloud of steam.

draugr_helmsman.name: Rotting-Anchor
draugr_helmsman.description: The Draugr's Thrumm-anchor drags souls into Iceheart's tide-grave. Swings a barnacle-crusted anchor.

draugr_helmsman.name: Sea-Salt-Curse
draugr_helmsman.description: The Draugr's Thrumm-anchor drags souls into Iceheart's tide-grave. Fills the victim's lungs with saltwater.

effects.name: Choking
effects.description: 1d8 damage per round; lungs full of salt water.

draugr_helmsman.name: Frost-Bind
draugr_helmsman.description: The Draugr's Thrumm-anchor drags souls into Iceheart's tide-grave. A ranged bolt of binding rime.

effects.name: Rooted
effects.description: Rooted in place for 1 round.

kappa.name: Beak-Snap
kappa.description: The Sump-Scrab's Thrumm-beak ripples Cragjaw's spirit-pools with ancient courtesy. A beak-lunge that drags into the pool.

kappa.name: River-Stone-Hurl
kappa.description: The Sump-Scrab's Thrumm-beak ripples Cragjaw's spirit-pools with ancient courtesy. Hurls a smooth river-stone.

kappa.name: Cucumber-Lure
kappa.description: The Sump-Scrab's Thrumm-beak ripples Cragjaw's spirit-pools with ancient courtesy. Can be bribed with a cucumber offering.

selectedEffects.name: Cucumber-Bribe
selectedEffects.description: DC 13 CHA to persuade it to move aside.

kitsune.name: Fox-Fire
kitsune.description: The Kitsune's Thrumm-foxfire dances with spirit-illusions through Cragjaw. Drifting fox-flames that charm.

effects.name: Charmed
effects.description: Charmed for 1 round.

kitsune.name: Shape-Shift
kitsune.description: The Kitsune's Thrumm-foxfire dances with spirit-illusions through Cragjaw. Takes the form of any person or animal.

selectedEffects.name: Disguise
selectedEffects.description: +6 to Deception checks.

kitsune.name: Nine-Tail-Illusions
kitsune.description: The Kitsune's Thrumm-foxfire dances with spirit-illusions through Cragjaw. Each tail stores an illusion it can deploy.

effects.name: Nine Illusions
effects.description: Can deploy one stored illusion per round.

tsuchinoko.name: Venom-Bite
tsuchinoko.description: The Tsuchinoko's Thrumm-venom numbs the spirit-threads of movement. A fang-bite of paralyzing venom.

tsuchinoko.name: Sake-Breath
tsuchinoko.description: The Tsuchinoko's Thrumm-venom numbs the spirit-threads of movement. Belches fumes that intoxicate.

selectedEffects.name: Intoxicated
selectedEffects.description: -2 to all checks for 1 hour.

tsuchinoko.name: Discorporate
tsuchinoko.description: The Tsuchinoko's Thrumm-venom numbs the spirit-threads of movement. Can discorporate into a thin slithering line.

effects.name: Discorporate
effects.description: Fits through any crack; nearly untrackable.

nopperabo.name: Blank-Gaze
nopperabo.description: The Nopperabo's Thrumm-blankness erases spirit-identity from memory. A featureless face that erases identity from the mind.

effects.name: Identity Loss
effects.description: Forgets who they are for 2 rounds.

nopperabo.name: Face-Steal
nopperabo.description: The Nopperabo's Thrumm-blankness erases spirit-identity from memory. Steals a victim's likeness.

selectedEffects.name: Stolen Face
selectedEffects.description: Takes the target's appearance for 3 rounds.

nopperabo.name: Featureless
nopperabo.description: The Nopperabo's Thrumm-blankness erases spirit-identity from memory. Its blank face unsettles all who see it.

effects.name: Featureless
effects.description: DC 12 SPI or shaken for 1 round on sight.

supayoni.name: Club-Smash
supayoni.description: The Oni's Thrumm-club trembles with Cragjaw's spirit-mountain rage. A stunning two-handed club-blow.

supayoni.name: Mountain-Toss
supayoni.description: The Oni's Thrumm-club trembles with Cragjaw's spirit-mountain rage. Hurls a boulder.

supayoni.name: Blizzard-Rage
supayoni.description: The Oni's Thrumm-club trembles with Cragjaw's spirit-mountain rage. Grows stronger each round of combat.

effects.name: Blizzard-Rage
effects.description: +2 STR per round of combat.

jorogumo.name: Web-Trap
jorogumo.description: The Jorogumo's Thrumm-silk weaves spirit-traps through Cragjaw's passes. Re-weaves a section into sticky web.

effects.name: Restrained
effects.description: Restrained by web.

jorogumo.name: Needle-Fang
jorogumo.description: The Jorogumo's Thrumm-silk weaves spirit-traps through Cragjaw's passes. A venomous bite.

jorogumo.name: Gold-Silk-Gown
jorogumo.description: The Jorogumo's Thrumm-silk weaves spirit-traps through Cragjaw's passes. A gown woven from gold-silk.

effects.name: Gold-Silk
effects.description: +8 to all social checks.

kodama.name: Echo-Voice
kodama.description: The Kodama's Thrumm-voice echoes Cragjaw's spirit through every valley. Repeats everything it hears with a 7-second delay.

selectedEffects.name: Echo-Relay
selectedEffects.description: Bounces sound across entire valleys; 100% reliable.

kodama.name: Peak-Warden
kodama.description: The Kodama's Thrumm-voice echoes Cragjaw's spirit through every valley. Bound to its mountain-Apu; wails when the mountain is harmed.

effects.name: Mountain-Warden
effects.description: DC 14 SPI or driven to tears when the mountain is damaged.

kodama.name: Quartz-Eyes
kodama.description: The Kodama's Thrumm-voice echoes Cragjaw's spirit through every valley. Sparkles in the dimmest light.

effects.name: Quartz-Eyes
effects.description: Reveals its position.

nurikabe.name: Path-Blocker
nurikabe.description: The Nurikabe's Thrumm-wall blocks spirit-pathways through the peaks. An impassable wall that extends as you climb or flank.

effects.name: Blocked Path
effects.description: Cannot be climbed, flanked, or broken; only a copper staff at the base moves it.

nurikabe.name: Living-Wall
nurikabe.description: The Nurikabe's Thrumm-wall blocks spirit-pathways through the peaks. Looks identical to surrounding rock.

effects.name: Camouflaged Wall
effects.description: Indistinguishable from rock.

nurikabe.name: Night-Architect
nurikabe.description: The Nurikabe's Thrumm-wall blocks spirit-pathways through the peaks. Rearranges mountain geography overnight.

selectedEffects.name: Geography Shift
selectedEffects.description: Paths clear yesterday are blocked today; dead-ends open.

nue.name: Nightmare-Cloud
nue.description: The Nue's Thrumm-cloud blankets Cragjaw in spirit-shared nightmares. A cloud of shared overlapping nightmares.

effects.name: Shared Nightmare
effects.description: Targets experience overlapping visions of their greatest fears for 1d4 rounds.

nue.name: Warm-Pocket
nue.description: The Nue's Thrumm-cloud blankets Cragjaw in spirit-shared nightmares. The cloud is warm and humid.

effects.name: Warm-Pocket
effects.description: Snow melts within it.

nue.name: Black-Snow
nue.description: The Nue's Thrumm-cloud blankets Cragjaw in spirit-shared nightmares. Where the cloud touches ground, snow turns black.

effects.name: Black-Snow
effects.description: Corrupts the ground it touches.

kasha.name: Claw-Pounce
kasha.description: Kasha's Thrumm-fur blazes with Cragjaw's spirit-funereal flame. A flaming pounce of claw and ember.

kasha.name: Flame-Fur
kasha.description: Kasha's Thrumm-fur blazes with Cragjaw's spirit-funereal flame. Pale blue-white extremely hot fire-fur.

effects.name: Flame-Fur
effects.description: Melee attackers take 1d6 fire on contact.

kasha.name: Corpse-Thief
kasha.description: Kasha's Thrumm-fur blazes with Cragjaw's spirit-funereal flame. Descends to steal a funeral-body.

selectedEffects.name: Corpse-Thief
selectedEffects.description: Steals a body; the spirit becomes a restless bridge-ghost.

tanuki.name: Toll-Trickster
tanuki.description: The Tanuki's Thrumm-trickery bends spirit-luck through Cragjaw's passes. Demands absurd tolls: a riddle, a song, a story.

selectedEffects.name: Absurd Toll
selectedEffects.description: Compliance yields a lucky illa-stone; refusal turns gear to leaves.

tanuki.name: Leaf-Hat
tanuki.description: The Tanuki's Thrumm-trickery bends spirit-luck through Cragjaw's passes. Gains invisibility for a brief moment.

selectedEffects.name: Invisible
selectedEffects.description: Invisible for 1 round; cannot attack.

tanuki.name: Sake-Flask
tanuki.description: The Tanuki's Thrumm-trickery bends spirit-luck through Cragjaw's passes. Offers sake that intoxicates.

effects.name: Intoxicated
effects.description: -2 to all checks for 1 hour.

ushioni.name: Sulfur-Breath
ushioni.description: The Ushi-Oni's Thrumm-sulfur chokes Cragjaw's spirit-corridors. A cone of toxic sulfur-gas.

ushioni.name: Bull-Head-Slam
ushioni.description: The Ushi-Oni's Thrumm-sulfur chokes Cragjaw's spirit-corridors. A bull-head charge.

ushioni.name: Obsidian-Web
ushioni.description: The Ushi-Oni's Thrumm-sulfur chokes Cragjaw's spirit-corridors. Volcanic-glass silk, invisible in steam.

effects.name: Snared
effects.description: DC 15 AGI to break, or 20 slashing to cut.

baku.name: Nightmare-Eater
baku.description: The Baku's Thrumm-trunk devours spirit-nightmares from Cragjaw's sleepers. Consumes a nightmare, leaving the sleeper refreshed.

selectedEffects.name: Devour Nightmare
selectedEffects.description: Sleeper wakes refreshed; no memory of bad dreams.

baku.name: Aura-of-Calm
baku.description: The Baku's Thrumm-trunk devours spirit-nightmares from Cragjaw's sleepers. A 20-ft aura of calm.

effects.name: undefined modification
effects.description: +4 to Spirit saves; immune to fear.

baku.name: Sacred-Huaca
baku.description: The Baku's Thrumm-trunk devours spirit-nightmares from Cragjaw's sleepers. Its claimed area is sacred ground.

effects.name: Sacred Ground
effects.description: No violence, Wyrd-corruption, or supernatural threat can enter.

nekomata.name: Corpse-Puppeteer
nekomata.description: The Nekomata's Thrumm-tails crackle with Cragjaw's spirit-lightning. Raises frozen dead as jerky puppets.

effects.name: Animated Corpses
effects.description: Animates frozen dead; movements synced to its tails.

nekomata.name: Tail-Slash
nekomata.description: The Nekomata's Thrumm-tails crackle with Cragjaw's spirit-lightning. A stunning twin-tail slash.

nekomata.name: Twin-Tail-Lightning
nekomata.description: The Nekomata's Thrumm-tails crackle with Cragjaw's spirit-lightning. Lightning arcs between tail-tips.

effects.name: Twin-Tail Arcs
effects.description: Each tail-flick can animate a corpse during storms.

futakuchi.name: Hair-Whip
futakuchi.description: The Futakuchi's Thrumm-mouth hungers for Cragjaw's deepest spirit. The second mouth's hair strikes independently.

futakuchi.name: Second-Mouth
futakuchi.description: The Futakuchi's Thrumm-mouth hungers for Cragjaw's deepest spirit. A hidden mouth that speaks the mountain's hunger.

effects.name: Second Mouth
effects.description: Speaks the hunger of the mountain itself.

futakuchi.name: Ration-Devour
futakuchi.description: The Futakuchi's Thrumm-mouth hungers for Cragjaw's deepest spirit. Consumes three times the rations of a normal person.

effects.name: Ration Devourer
effects.description: Consumes 3x rations while appearing to eat little.

wanyudo.name: Soul-Extraction
wanyudo.description: The Wanyudo's Thrumm-wheel compresses spirit-souls into screaming flame. Those who look directly lose their soul to the wheel.

effects.name: Soul Extracted
effects.description: Body frozen, face locked in horror; soul joins the wheel.

wanyudo.name: Cold-Fire
wanyudo.description: The Wanyudo's Thrumm-wheel compresses spirit-souls into screaming flame. Blue-white fire that gives cold, not heat.

effects.name: Cold-Fire
effects.description: Melee attackers take 2d6 frost.

wanyudo.name: Soul-Wheel
wanyudo.description: The Wanyudo's Thrumm-wheel compresses spirit-souls into screaming flame. A wheel of compressed flame and screaming faces.

effects.name: Soul-Wheel
effects.description: Appears as a merchant's cart from afar.

tsuchigumo.name: Gemstone-Beams
tsuchigumo.description: The Tsuchigumo's Thrumm-eyes fire Cragjaw's spirit-gems at his foes. Eight gemstone-eyes fire different elemental beams.

tsuchigumo.name: Mandible-Clash
tsuchigumo.description: The Tsuchigumo's Thrumm-eyes fire Cragjaw's spirit-gems at his foes. Metallic venom-slick mandibles.

tsuchigumo.name: Golden-Web
tsuchigumo.description: The Tsuchigumo's Thrumm-eyes fire Cragjaw's spirit-gems at his foes. Gold-silk stronger than cable; crystallizes blood.

effects.name: Blood Crystallizing
effects.description: Blood slowly crystallizes into metallic compounds.

akaname.name: Tongue-Lash
akaname.description: The Akaname's Thrumm-tongue licks Cragjaw's spirit-scale from the walls. A three-foot prehensile tongue.

akaname.name: Cleaning-Tool-Armament
akaname.description: The Akaname's Thrumm-tongue licks Cragjaw's spirit-scale from the walls. Wields brushes and scrapers as weapons.

akaname.name: Pipeline-Cleaner
akaname.description: The Akaname's Thrumm-tongue licks Cragjaw's spirit-scale from the walls. Licks mineral-scale from pipeline walls.

effects.name: Pipeline Cleaner
effects.description: A pipeline it infests flows three times more efficiently.

inugami.name: Loyalty-Fang
inugami.description: The Inugami's Thrumm-fangs bite with Cragjaw's spectral spirit-wrath. A spectral cold bite.

inugami.name: Ghost-Movement
inugami.description: The Inugami's Thrumm-fangs bite with Cragjaw's spectral spirit-wrath. Flickers, appearing to teleport.

effects.name: Flicker
effects.description: +8 to evasion.

inugami.name: Face-Project
inugami.description: The Inugami's Thrumm-fangs bite with Cragjaw's spectral spirit-wrath. Projects its face onto reflective surfaces.

effects.name: Face-Project
effects.description: Watches over multiple locations simultaneously.

ittan.name: Message-Bearer
ittan.description: The Ittan-momen's Thrumm-fabric carries Cragjaw's spirit-whispers. Carries a whisper the length of its fabric.

selectedEffects.name: Whisper-Message
selectedEffects.description: Cannot be intercepted or forged.

ittan.name: Smother-Sleep
ittan.description: The Ittan-momen's Thrumm-fabric carries Cragjaw's spirit-whispers. Wraps an attacker's face, forcing deep sleep.

effects.name: Dreamless Sleep
effects.description: Deep sleep for exactly 1 day.

ittan.name: Heart-Read
ittan.description: The Ittan-momen's Thrumm-fabric carries Cragjaw's spirit-whispers. Embroidered patterns rearrange into readable messages.

effects.name: Heart-Read
effects.description: Patterns reveal the observer's deepest concern.

gaki.name: Starving-Claw
gaki.description: The Gaki's Thrumm-hunger gnaws at the spirit-fabric of contentment. A desperate, hunger-driven rake.

gaki.name: Hunger-Aura
gaki.description: The Gaki's Thrumm-hunger gnaws at the spirit-fabric of contentment. An aura of gnawing, distracting hunger.

effects.name: Distracted by Hunger
effects.description: -2 to concentration and attack rolls.

gaki.name: Endless-Hunger
gaki.description: The Gaki's Thrumm-hunger gnaws at the spirit-fabric of contentment. Forever starving, never satisfied.

effects.name: Endless Hunger
effects.description: Cannot be satiated; driven to consume.

kamaitachi.name: Sickle-Cut
kamaitachi.description: The Kamaitachi's Thrumm-sickle cuts spirit-threads on Cragjaw's winds. A blindingly fast sickle-strike.

kamaitachi.name: Wind-Gale
kamaitachi.description: The Kamaitachi's Thrumm-sickle cuts spirit-threads on Cragjaw's winds. A mountain-wind blast that knocks foes prone.

effects.name: Pushed Prone
effects.description: Knocked prone and pushed 15 ft.

kamaitachi.name: Blade-Dance
kamaitachi.description: The Kamaitachi's Thrumm-sickle cuts spirit-threads on Cragjaw's winds. Moves between attacks without provoking.

effects.name: Blade-Dance
effects.description: Moves up to 20 ft between attacks without opportunity attacks.

kcoa.name: Lightning-Scratch
kcoa.description: The Kcoa's Thrumm-storm screeches through Cragjaw's spirit-torn skies. A crackling storm-charged scratch.

kcoa.name: Hail-Rain
kcoa.description: The Kcoa's Thrumm-storm screeches through Cragjaw's spirit-torn skies. A 15-ft radius of battering hail.

kcoa.name: Storm-Flight
kcoa.description: The Kcoa's Thrumm-storm screeches through Cragjaw's spirit-torn skies. Rides storm-winds; immune to fall damage.

effects.name: Storm-Flight
effects.description: Can hover and fly; immune to fall damage.

tengu_scout.name: Wind-Copper-Strike
tengu_scout.description: The Storm-Crow's Thrumm-gale carries spirit-messages across the peaks. A blow that resonates with slowing copper.

tengu_scout.name: Gale-Jump

effects.name: Flight

tengu_scout.name: Voice-Mimicry

effects.name: Voice-Mimicry
effects.description: Can mimic any voice it has heard with perfect accuracy.

almas.name: Root-Club

almas.name: Silent-Witness
almas.description: The Almas's Thrumm-memory holds Sundrift's sun-history in root and stone. Remembers the steppe's history for centuries.

selectedEffects.name: Steppe-History

almas.name: Snowshoe-Feet

effects.name: Snowshoe-Feet
effects.description: Ignores soft-soil difficult terrain.

tulpar.name: Starry-Cantrip
tulpar.description: The Tulpar's Thrumm-scales map sun-constellations across Sundrift's sky. A bolt of constellation-light.

tulpar.name: Sky-Memory
tulpar.description: The Tulpar's Thrumm-scales map sun-constellations across Sundrift's sky. Its scale-patterns hold the lost constellation-map.

effects.name: undefined modification

tulpar.name: Impossible-Capture
tulpar.description: The Tulpar's Thrumm-scales map sun-constellations across Sundrift's sky. Dissolves into starlight when bridled.

effects.name: Impossible-Capture
effects.description: Cannot be tamed; dissolves into starlight.

erlik.name: Bone-Strike
erlik.description: Erlik's Thrumm-bone weighs Sundrift's sun-debts on the Ancestor-Mounds. A blow that presses the weight of unpaid debts.

erlik.name: Soul-Judgment
erlik.description: Erlik's Thrumm-bone weighs Sundrift's sun-debts on the Ancestor-Mounds. Presides over the Ancestor-Mounds, judging the dead.

effects.name: Judged

erlik.name: Half-Alive
erlik.description: Erlik's Thrumm-bone weighs Sundrift's sun-debts on the Ancestor-Mounds. Half-flesh, half-skeleton.

effects.name: Dual-Voice

burkhan_wind.name: Sacred-Circle
burkhan_wind.description: The Burkhan's Thrumm-circle blesses Sundrift's sun-steppe with fertility. Its presence makes the surrounding land fertile.

effects.name: undefined modification
