burkhan_wind.description: The Burkhan's Thrumm-circle blesses Sundrift's sun-steppe with fertility. Petitioned for favorable weather by throat-singing.

burkhan_wind.name: Sacred-Presence
burkhan_wind.description: The Burkhan's Thrumm-circle blesses Sundrift's sun-steppe with fertility. Attacking it invites cosmic retribution.

effects.name: Sacred-Curse

nian.name: Horn-Gore
nian.description: The Nian's Thrumm-roar terrifies hostile creatures across Sundrift's plains. A burning horn-gore.

nian.description: The Nian's Thrumm-roar terrifies hostile creatures across Sundrift's plains. Repelled by loud noise, the color red, and fire.

effects.name: Red-Terror
effects.description: Attracted then repelled by red; frightened by loud noise and fire.

jiangshi.name: Qi-Drain
jiangshi.description: The Jiangshi's Thrumm-rigor locks sun-qi in frozen stiffness. A draining touch that saps life-force.

jiangshi.name: Talisman-Control
jiangshi.description: The Jiangshi's Thrumm-rigor locks sun-qi in frozen stiffness. A paper talisman redirects the Jiangshi.

selectedEffects.name: Redirect the Dead
selectedEffects.description: A new talisman with the correct ancestor-name redirects it.

jiangshi.name: Rigor-Freeze
jiangshi.description: The Jiangshi's Thrumm-rigor locks sun-qi in frozen stiffness. Frozen stiff in rigid posture.

effects.name: Rigor-Freeze
effects.description: Immune to grapple, prone, and knockback.

taotie_gorge.name: Spiral-Teeth
taotie_gorge.description: The Taotie's Thrumm-maw swallows Wyrd-essence into the Sundrift depths. Concentric rings of flesh-stripping teeth.

taotie_gorge.name: Pit-Trap
taotie_gorge.description: The Taotie's Thrumm-maw swallows Wyrd-essence into the Sundrift depths. A buried maw that swallows the unwary.

effects.name: Swallowed
effects.description: Plunges into the buried maw.

taotie_gorge.name: No-Eyes
taotie_gorge.description: The Taotie's Thrumm-maw swallows Wyrd-essence into the Sundrift depths. Hunts by smell and vibration; cannot be flanked.

effects.name: Blind-Hunter
effects.description: Invisible to scrying; cannot be flanked.

baize.name: Nine-Eye-Gaze
baize.description: Baize's Thrumm-eyes catalogue creatures across Sundrift's expanse. Each of its nine eyes fires a different colored beam.

baize.name: Living-Bestiary

selectedEffects.name: Living-Bestiary

baize.name: Omen-Appear
baize.description: Baize's Thrumm-eyes catalogue creatures across Sundrift's expanse. Appears only before major events.

effects.name: Omen-Appear
effects.description: Nine eyes encode the event's nature and severity.

zilant_wing.name: Beak-Slam
zilant_wing.description: The Zilant's Thrumm-wings sing sun-tones across Sundrift's sky. A piercing beak-strike.

zilant_wing.name: Wing-Song
zilant_wing.description: The Zilant's Thrumm-wings sing sun-tones across Sundrift's sky. Wind through wing-veins produces a resonant tone.

effects.name: Wing-Song Navigation

zilant_wing.name: Forked-Tongue
zilant_wing.description: The Zilant's Thrumm-wings sing sun-tones across Sundrift's sky. Tastes the air for 200 ft.

effects.name: Forked-Tongue
effects.description: Detects all creatures within 200 ft.

susulu_spring.name: Healing-Spring
susulu_spring.description: The Susulu's Thrumm-spring heals sun-wounds with Sundrift's blessing. Spring water mends wounds.

effects.name: Slowed

susulu_spring.name: Pure-Source
susulu_spring.description: The Susulu's Thrumm-spring heals sun-wounds with Sundrift's blessing. Its waters are eternally pure.

effects.name: Pure-Source
effects.description: Water it tends cures disease on contact.

dijiang_chaos.name: Chaos-Burst
dijiang_chaos.description: Dijiang's Thrumm-drum beats sun-chaos through Sundrift's fabric. A roiling burst of pure chaos.

effects.name: Confused
effects.description: Confused for 2 rounds.

dijiang_chaos.name: Faceless

effects.name: Faceless
effects.description: Immune to charm and fear.

fenghuang_migrate.name: Radiant-Renewal

fenghuang_migrate.name: Auspicious-Presence

effects.name: Auspicious

qiongqi_scourge.name: Wing-Rake

qiongqi_scourge.name: Predator-Sense

zhenniao_toxin.name: Venom-Spit

ubagan_crystal.name: Mud-Grasp

effects.description: -2 to Charisma checks until atoned.

bannik_vent.description: The Bannik's Thrumm-steam carries bog-omens from Bryngloom's vents. Reads the future in the steam.

selectedEffects.name: Steam-Reading
selectedEffects.description: Reveals a cryptic omen.

psoglav_bone.name: Bone-Crush-Jaw
psoglav_bone.description: The Psoglav's Thrumm-bone gaze pierces Bryngloom's bog-shadows. A crushing bite of iron teeth.

psoglav_bone.name: Death-Gaze
psoglav_bone.description: The Psoglav's Thrumm-bone gaze pierces Bryngloom's bog-shadows. Multiple eyes gleam with killing intent.

effects.name: Shaken
effects.description: -2 to all rolls under its gaze.

psoglav_bone.name: Bone-Armor
psoglav_bone.description: The Psoglav's Thrumm-bone gaze pierces Bryngloom's bog-shadows. A hide of fused bone.

effects.name: Bone-Armor
effects.description: Resistant to physical damage.

vourdalak_debt.name: Kin-Drain
vourdalak_debt.description: The Vourdalak's Thrumm-blood-debt demands bog-payment in kin. Feeds first on its own kin.

vourdalak_debt.name: Blood-Debt
vourdalak_debt.description: The Vourdalak's Thrumm-blood-debt demands bog-payment in kin. A curse that demands blood repayment.

effects.name: Blood-Debt
effects.description: Owes the vampire; loses 1d4 HP per round until paid.

vourdalak_debt.name: Undead-Vitality
vourdalak_debt.description: The Vourdalak's Thrumm-blood-debt demands bog-payment in kin. Rises again unless properly slain.

effects.name: Undead-Vitality
effects.description: Regenerates 5 HP per round.

mavka_willow.name: Willow-Lure
mavka_willow.description: The Mavka's Thrumm-roots drag victims through Bryngloom's bog-waters. A voice like wind through willows lures victims to the water.

effects.name: Lured
effects.description: Compelled toward the water.

mavka_willow.name: Root-Grasp
mavka_willow.description: The Mavka's Thrumm-roots drag victims through Bryngloom's bog-waters. Willow-roots drag victims down.

mavka_willow.name: Water-Soul
mavka_willow.description: The Mavka's Thrumm-roots drag victims through Bryngloom's bog-waters. Her soul is the river itself.

effects.name: Water-Soul
effects.description: Cannot be harmed while submerged.

alkonost.name: Dawn-Song
alkonost.description: Alkonost's Thrumm-dawn-song weaves bog-hope through Bryngloom. A song of dawn that charms all who hear.

effects.name: Charmed

alkonost.name: Morning-Light
alkonost.description: Alkonost's Thrumm-dawn-song weaves bog-hope through Bryngloom. Warms and invigorates allies.

effects.name: undefined modification

alkonost.name: Storm-Call

effects.description: Can summon or disperse storms.

dziwozona_wild.name: Thorn-Lash
dziwozona_wild.description: The Dziwozona's Thrumm-thorn whip cuts through Bryngloom's bog-brambles. A whip of bramble and thorn.

effects.name: Whirlwind-Step

dziwozona_wild.name: Wild-Strength
dziwozona_wild.description: The Dziwozona's Thrumm-thorn whip cuts through Bryngloom's bog-brambles. Impossibly strong for her frame.

effects.name: Wild-Strength
effects.description: +4 to Strength checks.

upir_root.name: Life-Force-Drain
upir_root.description: The Upir's Thrumm-blood-control binds bog-victims in Bryngloom's thrall. Drains life-force through touch.

upir_root.description: The Upir's Thrumm-blood-control binds bog-victims in Bryngloom's thrall. Controls any creature that drank its blood.

effects.name: Blood-Thrall
effects.description: Must obey the Upir for 1 hour.

upir_root.name: Regeneration
upir_root.description: The Upir's Thrumm-blood-control binds bog-victims in Bryngloom's thrall. Regenerates rapidly; only radiant stops it.

effects.name: Regeneration
effects.description: Regenerates 15 HP per round; stopped by radiant.

sirin_song.name: Song-of-Death
sirin_song.description: Sirin's Thrumm-song-of-death carries Bryngloom's final bog-whisper. A song of final words that can break the heart.

effects.name: Heartbreak
effects.description: Those who hear the full song die of heartbreak within 24 hours (SPI 16+ resists).

sirin_song.name: Sorrow-Aura
sirin_song.description: Sirin's Thrumm-song-of-death carries Bryngloom's final bog-whisper. A 30-ft aura of overwhelming grief.

effects.description: Gain 1 level of exhaustion.

sirin_song.name: Healing-Tears
sirin_song.description: Sirin's Thrumm-song-of-death carries Bryngloom's final bog-whisper. Weeps tears of light that mend wounds.

skerry.name: Ice-Spike
skerry.description: The Skerry's Thrumm-ice spikes through Bryngloom's winter-cold waters. Hurls a shard of sea-ice.

skerry.name: Siren-Grasp

effects.name: Dragged Under

skerry.description: The Skerry's Thrumm-ice spikes through Bryngloom's winter-cold waters. At home in the coldest seas.

effects.name: Amphibious
effects.description: Swim 50; immune to cold.

nachtkrapp.name: Ash-Cloud
nachtkrapp.description: The Nachtrapp's Thrumm-coal snatch steals winter-light from the Bryngloom dark. Vents a cloud of hot soot.

effects.description: Blinded and coughing for 1 round.

effects.name: Night-Flight
effects.description: Flies silently; perfect night-vision.

glacier_gremlin.name: Frost-Lick

effects.name: Slowed
effects.description: Movement speed halved.

effects.name: Cold-Blooded
effects.description: Resistant to frost; vulnerable to fire.

nokk_stallion.name: Mist-Lure
nokk_stallion.description: The Nokk's Thrumm-mist lures victims into Bryngloom's winter-pools. A charm that compels the target toward the water.

effects.name: Charmed
effects.description: Compelled to move toward the Nokk.

nokk_stallion.name: Drown
nokk_stallion.description: The Nokk's Thrumm-mist lures victims into Bryngloom's winter-pools. A grapple that drags beneath the surface.

nokk_stallion.name: Water-Dash

selectedEffects.name: Freezing Dash
selectedEffects.description: Leaves a trail of ice.

wolpertinger.name: Antler-Prod

wolpertinger.description: The Wolpertinger's Thrumm-antlers prod Bryngloom's fey-foliage. Blends into forest foliage.

effects.name: Camouflage
effects.description: +5 to stealth in forest foliage.

effects.name: Charmed

huldra.name: Wood-Slam
huldra.description: The Huldra's Thrumm-song entices through Bryngloom's winter-trees. A supernatural-strength blow.

selectedEffects.name: Tree-Meld

qalupalik.name: Amautik-Snatch

selectedEffects.name: Ice-Dive

bixie.name: Ward-Roar

vila.name: Wind-Lash

effects.name: Mud-Drag
